limitations: Two bare repeats per case; not a confidence interval.
Coarse timers used for primary phase accounting; probe disproportionately perturbs legacy.
Outside selected MPI scopes is elapsed time, not hardware CPU time.
No cache-miss, DRAM-bandwidth or usable measured CPU-frequency evidence.
Phase means account for locations, not recoverable savings.
Stage199 CPU mapping differs: historical timing change is not a controlled causal comparison.
recommendation: Keep verified 83-task two-socket LLC-spread placement. Next investigate whole wavelet and remaining-dynamics representation/data-movement paths with calibrated matched instruction/cycle/cache/stall sampling; require a source-level mechanism and credible >=0.10 s/step recovery before optimizing.
